Combine game tests with reading and appending results

Unit 1 · Week 7 · Lesson 3 · Suggested 55-minute plan; adjust to local timing.

Prepare: Before class verify the nominated editor uses a school-approved Python/Pygame installation. Extract the whole pygame-teaching-pack.zip into a writable disposable folder. Open https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4 and workbook.md, faded_practice.py, practice-tests.csv and readiness.csv. Run python lab_runner.py 4. Use supplied named state/runner infrastructure; no student-authored classes, paid media or assessed project code. Record device, interpreter and support. Paper traces support reasoning; live window/keyboard evidence remains necessary. The suggested 55-minute allocation is untrialled; use the supplied 50-minute adaptation when required.

Suggested answers are teacher guidance, not extra assessment tasks. These notes are public.

Open the matching Pygame lab · Practice workbook · Test record · Readiness record

1. Test the game and preserve its history

Suggested time: 2 minutes

Instructional strategy: Learning intention

Run python lab_runner.py 4 in a disposable extracted folder. The worked lab accepts integer history scores0..2; the changed lab accepts0,2,4,6. Success: distinguish missing/empty/malformed data, append once after finished, show a visible failed write and retry, and retain pause/reset/timeout evidence. Stage4 uses the same two-station lab; Week7 Lesson4 controlled practical stays unchanged. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Worked files and changed scaffold are public formative resources. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

2. Retrieve modes and validation

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Individual retrieval and paired correction

Append a retains prior text; w truncates an existing file. An empty file opens and traverses zero records; missing raises FileNotFoundError unless handled. int("3") converts but3 is invalid for the worked0..2 score policy. Missing history is intentionally treated as no previous scores here; it is a stated lab policy, not a universal rule. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Worked files and changed scaffold are public formative resources. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

3. Read each score and check its domain

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Teacher model and worked record trace

Excerpt from rules.load_history; the omitted surrounding try handles missing as empty and other read/encoding errors with a warning. int strips/converts, then the domain check rejects out-of-range integers. Worked policy accepts0,1,2. Malformed or out-of-range lines are skipped with their line number in warnings; valid later lines are still processed. Model a file containing 2,three,1,9: valid[2,1], warnings for lines2 and4. Empty and missing both yield[] with no warnings under this lab policy. Do not reuse the previous chapter’s whole-file-rejection policy without stating the difference. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Worked files and changed scaffold are public formative resources. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

4. Append only after a successful finish

Suggested time: 10 minutes

Instructional strategy: Predict, model and inspect file state

Focused success-path excerpt of save_result. The complete supplied function wraps the open/write in try/except OSError and returns a visible Not saved message while leaving saved=False. Only after the with block succeeds is saved=True. The runner attempts automatically once when finished and S explicitly retries a failed write. Reset creates a fresh unsaved state for the next run while keeping old file records. Test full supplied function, not this excerpt alone. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Worked files and changed scaffold are public formative resources. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

5. Specify expected results before testing

Suggested time: 6 minutes

Instructional strategy: Guided test design and paired reasoning

Model pause and timeout with rule tests, then observe live transitions in the runner. Paused95000 ms update leaves x and remaining unchanged. Starting/resuming/resetting discards that frame’s delta. An update with remaining50 and dt50 finishes with remaining0 before movement/collection, so an overlapping station earns no late point. Two successful saves on the same finished state append one row. A failed target (use an existing disposable directory as the path) returns Not saved and leaves saved=False; retry with a writable file. Never change real school permissions to simulate failure. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Worked files and changed scaffold are public formative resources. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

6. Complete the changed history policy

Suggested time: 12 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent faded task and changed tests

Use a COPY; complete load_history and save_result without importing lab_rules. Prediction file 2,three,3,6,0 gives[2,6,0] and warnings for lines2 and3; missing/empty gives[]. A finished score6 appends once; a second call leaves file unchanged. Reject odd scores in the changed history policy, even though int conversion succeeds. The save contract assumes a valid score from the game; the loader validates external records. For a failed save, target a disposable directory, check saved=False, then retry with a writable file. Complete practice-tests.csv expected/actual/build evidence. After rule checks use the previously adapted runner; drawing and file I/O remain separate from scoring. Teaching lab and matching workbook: https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/index.html#y11-4; https://edugenio.github.io/cs-atar-textbook/pygame/workbook.md. Relevant Pygame references: https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/event.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/time.html ; https://www.pygame.org/docs/ref/rect.html .

7. When should saved become True?

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: All-student hinge question

B. A prevents a legitimate retry and falsely claims persistence. Ask learners to distinguish an expected result from an observed file change. The worked runner avoids automatic repeated failures each frame: it attempts once and S retries explicitly. Record the error message without exposing real file paths or student data. 8. Demonstrate and record readiness

Suggested time: 5 minutes

Instructional strategy: Independent exit demonstration and feedback

Use readiness.csv y11-4 plus the practice test table. Teacher observes one changed rule or test after the independent attempt; copying check_worked_lab output is not evidence of the learner’s own work. Record support, code version, expected/actual, first mismatch, repair and retest. Keep formal practical conditions separate next lesson; this preparation is ungraded. If evidence is incomplete, record targeted reteaching and re-plan before project issue rather than quietly adding workshops.
